title: feat(mesh): MESH-MAT-001 fixture-only material evidence + orthotropic research sidecars
intent: Implement the amended MESH-MAT-001 rulings against current main: ToolBox-local MaterialEvidenceBundle under app.mesh.materials, ADR-0012 epistemic vocabulary, explicit OrthotropicPlate construction (no from_wood default, no inverse_solver), and research-only prediction/residual sidecars. Do not restore deleted fields/retopo scaffold; do not mutate qa_core or cam_policy; do not accept caller HARDWARE=true.
behavior_change: Adds a new research-only material evidence → orthotropic state → Rayleigh–Ritz prediction → residual comparison surface under services/api/app/mesh/materials/. New JSON contracts material_evidence, material_prediction, and prediction_residual are registered. No manufacturing-policy or qa_core behavior changes. Missing E_C fails closed. Assumptions (G_LC, Poisson) serialize as ModelAssumption metadata, not as EpistemicStatus.

diff_articulation.what_changed: (1) New app.mesh.materials package: evidence importer with ADR-0012 EpistemicStatus, HARDWARE=true rejection, SI canonicalization; OrthotropicMaterialState.from_evidence with ModelAssumption serialization and fail-closed missing E_C; predict_plate_modes wrapping solve_rayleigh_ritz with epistemic_status=predicted and research_only=true; compare_modal_prediction residual sidecar. (2) Contracts + schema_registry entries for material_evidence, material_prediction, prediction_residual. (3) Fixture-only spruce evidence + incomplete E_C fixture. (4) 19 unit tests covering import rules, orthotropic assumptions, prediction, residuals, schema validation, and package boundaries (no from_wood, no inverse_solver import, not under app.materials, no qa_core/cam_policy touch). (5) Handoff documenting amended Q1–Q7 rulings.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: app.materials is the curated tonewood registry; this is specimen-specific research evidence. Mesh Pipeline v0.1.0 fields/retopo were deliberately removed and are not restored. DO-103 Stage 3 HARDWARE provenance is deferred behind an adapter seam.
